The evidence should be admitted: under FRE 414, in a criminal case where the defendant is accused of child molestation, evidence of prior similar acts of child molestation may be considered for any relevant purpose, including propensity, subject only to FRE 403 balancing. The judge should therefore overrule the objection and admit the evidence unless its probative value is substantially outweighed by unfair prejudice.
CONFIDENCE: 95
